stages.name: Plan
stages.does: Turns the ask into searches, hashtags and a keep/drop rule.

output.NAME: black-teen-hooper-scroll
output.TITLE: Black Teen Guys' Hoop & Comedy Scroll
output.WHOSE_SCROLL: A Black teen guy, 15-19, in Atlanta/DMV/Chicago/Houston who scrolls hooper highlight edits, barbershop banter, and relatable comedy skits between class and pickup ball.
output.KEEP_RULE: A post belongs if it's a skit, hooper highlight/edit, meme, or comedy bit made purely to be funny or hype — nothing about skin, products, or self-improvement.
output.DROP_RULE: Drop skincare/grooming tips, sneaker or gear reviews, 'get ready with me'/self-improvement content, and anything pitching a product or routine — these look adjacent but are the wrong lane.

stages.name: Pull
stages.does: Runs every search on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube; turns away ads, old posts and small posts at the door.

stages.name: Sift
stages.does: Sorts every new post into a lane: entertainment, educational, selling or junk. Only the first two stay.
